actors.title: Recruiter
actors.description: Opens job positions, registers candidates, and manages applications through the hiring pipeline except offer and hiring decisions.

actors.title: Hiring Manager
actors.description: Decides offers and hiring for candidates applying to their job positions.

authorities.title: Manage hiring pipeline
authorities.description: Open and manage job positions, register candidates, and manage applications through screening, interview, and rejection.

authorities.title: Decide hiring outcomes
authorities.description: Review applications and position capacity and decide offer and hiring outcomes for responsible job positions.

dataScope.description: All hiring pipeline records in the organization.

disclosure.description: Recruiters can view complete job position, candidate, and application records needed to manage the pipeline.

dataScope.description: Only job positions for which the hiring manager is responsible, their applications, and the candidates associated with those applications.

disclosure.description: Hiring managers can view complete responsible position, associated candidate, and application records needed for offer and hiring decisions.
